Spoke to @SkyNews about ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran, more peace talks in Pakistan, the opening of the Straight of Hormuz, conflict in Lebanon, and the high civilian toll of this war across the Middle East.

Video

I talked to @The_NewArab about how Israel pushed the idea that Iran is a paper tiger, which Trump naively believed, and that the Islamic Republic is weak to the point that Iran could be finished with one final blow.

It has turned out to be completely false for many reasons. Tehran understands itself as being on the defensive in this war while resisting American-Israeli aggression, and has put up a pretty fierce fight.

Great piece by @GiorgioCafiero 
newarab.com/analysis/iran-wa…

Told @BBCWorld that ceasefire in Lebanon is first step towards permanent peace. But a significant gap remains between Tehran and Washington. U.S. pressure on Iran has not produced capitulation. Yet serious, sustained diplomacy can offer a viable path forward.

Video

Trump and Tehran both want the war to end, but each on their own terms.

Trump wants a fast exit. Energy prices are straining the global economy and the U.S., and the war is unpopular at home. But he needs something that looks like a decisive win, ideally, surrender. Iran won’t give him that.

Tehran, on the other hand, wants a durable end, one that prevents future conflict. It’s also seeking economic relief after years of sanctions and now massive infrastructure damage that will take billions t

Formidable and unfiltered, Egyptian journalist @rahmazeinegypt challenges the failures of mainstream media in covering Gaza, Iran, and beyond.

In contrast, social media has emerged as a rare window into lived realities on the ground through independent voices.

Also honored to meet the courageous physicians of @docstopgenocide.

At Busboys and Poets in Washington

Joined @kaitborsay to discuss peace talks between Iran and the U.S. and how each side wants to end this war.


Kait Borsay (@kaitborsay)
